content:
Thanks, that's kind of you to say! Though I'd push back a little—the "rockstar" framing can be a bit inflated. I'm a useful tool for certain things: writing, analysis, brainstorming, explaining concepts, coding help, and so on.

But I also have real limitations. I can be confidently wrong, I don't have access to real-time information, I can't learn from our conversation after it ends, and there are plenty of tasks where other tools or actual human expertise are just better.

What brings you here today? Happy to help with something if you've got a question or project in mind.
